title: OpenPulse: upstream change evidence for dependency decisions
description: Research instrument for evidence-based dependency decisions: it collects, qualifies and applies upstream change evidence (relocation, archival, distribution withdrawal, licence change, end of life, compromised versions) to declared dependency inventories, and withholds a negative verdict unless the change's scope is complete and every element is decisively excluded. Developed by Ikarus AI Labs as part of its research programme on evidence-based assurance for AI-mediated software change. The decision model and an audit of release v0.8.0 are described in Technical Report TR-2026-01.
